title: Request Detail Parallels — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An extra approver for a step, named by job title and workflow role. Workflow role cannot be blank. Not read at present: approvers come only from the step itself, so these rows do not add anyone.

fields.label: RequestDetails
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Request Detail master data.
fields.html: What it is. The step this approver is added to.

fields.label: JobTitle
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Job Title master data.
fields.html: What it is. The job title of the extra approver.

fields.label: WorkflowRole
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Workflow Role master data.
fields.html: What it is. The workflow role of the extra approver.
